messages:
mike_sales: FYI — closed BlueHorizon (midmarket). Passing to CS for kickoff + handoff to eng/support. Main asks from the sales call:
- Dedicated capacity reserved starting 2025-05-01
- SSO (Okta/SAML) + SCIM sync for provisioning
- 90d logs retention and whitelisted egress IPs for audits
- Initial workload ~3M tokens/day, stream-heavy chat; target <300ms p50 latency
- Enablement session for their infra/dev team + an eval prompt set for Optimize
- Procurement flagged renewal & SLA concerns (they want 12mo SLA + SOC2 clause)

sarah_csm: Thanks @mike_sales — I’ll own kickoff. Setting a pre-kickoff sync Tue 2025-04-29 10:00 PT with BlueHorizon, sales, cs, eng. Owners below:
- CS kickoff & success plan: sarah_csm
- Provisioning & billing commit: anita_cs_ops
- VPC peering & infra sizing: devon_eng
- Support runbook & oncall: julia_support

anita_cs_ops: Need these from sales/customer ASAP:
1) Customer CIDR for peering
2) Desired model variants + max sequence length
3) Billing/legal PO reference for reserved capacity commit
I'll open infra tickets once CIDR + PO are in. Tentative provisioning: 10 business days after requirements complete.

devon_eng: To size the dedicated pool we need baseline traffic samples and expected concurrency. Please upload a short streaming trace (curl) to the ticket so we can run perf baselines.

Suggested runtime snippet:
```yaml
runtime:
  deployment: dedicated
  gpu_count: 4
  model_variant: redwood-7b-quant
  kv_cache: enabled
  retention_days: 90
  network: vpc-peering
```

julia_support: I’ll draft the support runbook + incident SLA doc. Assign the ticket to me when provisioning starts. Also need primary BlueHorizon contacts for infra and product.

mike_sales: Primary contacts: elaine.martin@bluehorizon.com (infra lead), raj.patel@bluehorizon.com (product). PO inbound, should land EOD tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Created task CS-4592: "BlueHorizon dedicated provisioning" and linked to infra queue. ETA auto: 2025-05-12.

anita_cs_ops: Opening infra ticket now and attaching the requirements checklist. Pulled draft billing commit template into ticket. @devon_eng — is 4 GPUs OK as a starting point or should we wait for traffic samples?

devon_eng: 4 GPUs should be fine for ~3M tokens/day if concurrency <40. For sustained bursts >100 concurrent streams we’d scale to 8+. We’ll validate after baseline.

sarah_csm: Owners & next steps (please react :white_check_mark: if you accept):
- sarah_csm: kickoff + success plan (invite sent)
- anita_cs_ops: infra ticket + provisioning (due 2025-05-12)
- devon_eng: perf baseline + VPC peering (ETA after sample)
- julia_support: support runbook + oncall switchover
- sales: provide PO + CIDR + contacts (mike_sales)
I’ll run a 3-question quick enablement survey after kickoff and attach responses to CS-4592 (1) onboarding clarity (2) infra docs usefulness (3) missing guarantees.

mike_sales: Will push PO + CIDR. +1 on survey.

julia_support: Can CS prep a short "expected latency/throughput" 1-pager to share with their SREs pre-kickoff?

sarah_csm: Yes — drafting a 1-pager today and attaching to the calendar invite.

anita_cs_ops: Adding the dedicated runbook link to the ticket: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-provisioning and a provisioning checklist.

devon_eng: If someone can attach historical prompt sets used for Optimize regressions, that’ll help model variant selection. Otherwise we’ll start with redwood-7b-quant and iterate.

mike_sales: Will upload a sanitized prompt sample (no PII) to the ticket.

sarah_csm: Goal: provisioning started by 2025-04-30 if no blockers. Flag any legal/renewal SLA issues here and I’ll escalate to finance/legal as needed.

julia_support: Acknowledged — prepping runbook, waiting for ticket assignment.

mike_sales: Note on renewal: customer asked about early-termination for pilot month. Sales negotiated a 60-day pilot; finance/legal needs to confirm SLA/term language.

sarah_csm: Noted — I’ll open a finance/legal thread if PO isn’t updated by EOD tomorrow.

(END)
